title: Relay key made (POST /api/tournaments/:slug/relay-keys, 201)
description: Reader: OpenPairings, which hands relay_key to its Alnasl box; Alnasl then sends it as the Bearer credential on live-board updates. Cache-Control: no-store; the key is in this reply and nowhere else. Refusals: 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required, key_mismatch, not_owner, tournament_hidden, installation_suspended, installation_revoked, address_blocked; 404 tournament_not_published; 409 relay_key_limit; 429 rate_limited (six a tournament per ten minutes, POST and DELETE together); 503 publishing_paused. A server from before this route answers Phoenix's own 404 with no `error` code.

relay_key.description: orrk_ and 43 characters (32 random bytes, base64url).

hint.description: The key's last four characters, what the admin panel shows.

replaced.description: How many of this publisher's keys under the same label were revoked by this request.
